market_regime_definition.rule: regime(T) = UP if close(T_last_before_T) > median(close of the 120 trading days ending at T_last_before_T, all trade_date < T), else DOWN
market_regime_definition.rationale: one parameter only; 120 trading days spans two quarterly disclosure cycles (1-3 month publication lag), damping single-month noise; median (not mean) for robustness; no thresholds to tune

inherited_gates: R4 hard gate in full: naive direction + date-dedup direction + leave-max-cluster-out direction + >=5 distinct dates per side; observation-date cluster control is NEVER dropped because context was added

analysis_policy_I4B.insufficient_context_coverage_rule: preregistered floor = 3 distinct observation dates per cell x regime stratum (met at freeze time); if any stratum falls below at I4B time it is marked INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT_COVERAGE and reported as not-testable — regime merging, threshold changes, or any other rescue is FORBIDDEN
analysis_policy_I4B.context_classification_rule: deterministic, computed on date-dedup deltas per stratum (d_U, d_D) vs the overall date-dedup delta (d_all): CONTEXT_ROBUST iff sign(d_U)=sign(d_D)=sign(d_all); CONDITIONAL iff sign(d_all) equals the I3 direction and exactly one stratum flips sign; MARKET_COMPOSITION_DEPENDENT iff both strata contradict the I3 direction (overall direction then rests on regime composition). Ties/zero handled by sign()=None -> not classifiable, reported as such
analysis_policy_I4B.few_context_principle: exactly ONE index, ONE regime definition, NO additional indicators; the question is whether two preregistered relations survive market context — not model building
